presentation.title: Start with the fleet you already have
presentation.body: Stado's canonical registry is the declaration shared by the CLI, Desktop, coordinator, and workers. If you already have a Stado registry-v2 JSON export, adopt it instead of recreating its hosts and fleets. Import reads no host, runs no workload, installs nothing, and changes no service.

presentation.title: Choose an existing registry-v2 JSON file
presentation.body: The import validates the complete source before reading the destination, adds destination-missing named targets and fleets, preserves destination-only state, and refuses every differing record or value. Repeating the same import reports those records unchanged. Omit this optional action to keep an empty, usable local registry.
presentation.result: The exact imported and unchanged host and fleet names, conflicts or validation rejection, and the accepted canonical generation

presentation.title: Accept the registry into canonical storage
presentation.body: Run the import command with your file. The journey completes only after the registry operation compare-and-swaps the merged document and reads the accepted generation back. A rejected source or conflict leaves the canonical registry byte-for-byte unchanged.
presentation.result: A stado.registry-import-receipt.v1 receipt with state imported or unchanged
